events.title: Democratic opening: electoral democracy index rose 0.61 over 5 years
events.detail: From 0.01 in 1867 to 0.62 in 1922. Derived by detecting a sustained shift of at least 0.2 index points over 5 years; marked at the steepest year of the episode.
events.contested: V-Dem indices are aggregated expert judgements with published uncertainty intervals. A shift of this size is well outside the noise, but the exact year is a property of the detection rule, not a documented event.

events.title: Inflation crossed 50% (reached 104%)
events.detail: Consumer price inflation rose from 19.1% to 103.6%, crossing the 50% threshold.
events.source: derived: World Bank consumer price inflation
events.contested: The 50% line is a convention, not a natural boundary. Official inflation statistics are also among the most manipulated numbers governments publish, so the true figure may be higher than the one recorded here.

events.title: Balcerowicz Plan
events.detail: Price controls were lifted, subsidies cut, the currency made convertible and trade opened, in a single package at the start of 1990.
events.contested: Poland recovered its pre-transition output level faster than most of the region, which is often cited for big-bang reform. Critics note the depth of the initial recession and the persistence of regional unemployment, and point out that Poland also had debt relief and EU accession prospects that others lacked.
events.refs: ["Balcerowicz, 'Socialism, Capitalism, Transformation' (1995)", "Sachs, 'Poland's Jump to the Market Economy' (1993)"]
